title: E/1051/2011 — Shree Ganesh Knit (india) Ltd vs. Ahmedabad-i
text:
In The Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
West Zonal Bench At Ahmedabad
C/EH/10058/2018 & E/EH/10121/2018
Appeal No.C/10488/2017-DB
[Arising out of OIA-AHM-CUSTM-000-APP-064-16-17 dated 02.01.2017 passed by the C.C. Ahmedabad]
Appeal No.E/1051/2011-DB
[Arising out of OIO-06/COMMISSIONER/RAJU/AHD-I/2011 dated 27.05.2011 passed by the C.C.E
Ahmedabad]
M/s Petronet Lng Limited Appellant
Shree Ganesh Knit (india) Ltd.
Vs
C.C. Ahmedabad Respondent
C.C.E. Ahmedabad-I
Represented by:
For Appellant: None
For Respondent: Mr. L. Patra and Mrs. Nitina Nagori (A.R.)
CORAM:
HON’BLE PRESIDENT DR. SATISH CHANDRA
HON’BLE MR. C.J. MATHEW, MEMBER (TECHNICAL)
Date of Hearing/Decision:25.04.2018
Misc. Order No. M / 10308-10309 /2018
Per: Dr. Satish Chandra
None present on behalf of the assessee. Heard Sh. L. Patra and
Mrs. Nitina Nagori. After hearing the Ld. AR of the Department, early
hearing is allowed for the reasons mentioned in the application. List the
appeal for final hearing on priority basis.
(Dictated and pronounced in the open court)
(JUSTICE DR. SATISH CHANDRA)
PRESIDENT
(C.J. MATHEW)
MEMBER (TECHNICAL)
